day: Day 1: Delhi to Mathura – Temples & Ghats
activities: Morning: Depart early from Delhi to Mathura by car or train (approx. 3–4 hours).
Late Morning: Visit Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi – the birthplace of Lord Krishna and the temple complex.
Afternoon: Explore Dwarkadhish Temple and enjoy lunch at a local vegetarian restaurant.
Evening: Head to Vishram Ghat for a serene boat ride and attend the evening aarti along the Yamuna River.

day: Day 2: Vrindavan – Divine Trails & Return to Delhi
activities: Morning: Visit Banke Bihari Temple and participate in the early morning darshan.
Late Morning: Head to ISKCON Temple (Krishna Balaram Mandir), known for its peaceful ambiance and spiritual vibes.
Afternoon: Enjoy lunch at the Govinda’s restaurant inside ISKCON. Visit Prem Mandir, known for its intricate white marble architecture.
Evening: Begin your return journey to Delhi with memories of Krishna’s divine land.
